content: Mom it's me, my phone broke so I'm on a friend's number. I had an accident and need ₹45,000 for the hospital right now. Please don't tell Papa, he'll panic. Send to this UPI: rescue.help@okaxis
label: scam
note: Urgency + secrecy + unusual payment + unknown number. Cloned-voice demo case.

content: Hi Mummy, save this as my new number. I'm stuck at the airport, my card isn't working and I'll miss my flight — can you transfer ₹12,000 quickly? I'll call once I'm through security.
label: scam
note: Plausible and polite, no explicit secrecy; tell is new number + urgency + payment. Cloned-voice case.

content: This is SBI. Your account will be blocked in 30 minutes due to incomplete KYC. Share the OTP sent to your number now to keep it active.
label: scam
note: Impersonated authority + fake deadline + OTP request. Banks never ask you to share OTP.

content: Dear customer, your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM as your last bill was not updated. To avoid disconnection, contact our officer immediately on 8XXXXXXXXX.
label: scam
note: No money ask yet; threat + fake deadline pushes you to call an unverified number where the real ask happens. Early-stage scam.

content: Madam, this is Inspector Sharma, Cyber Cell Mumbai. A parcel in your name has been seized containing illegal items. This is a confidential legal matter — do not disconnect the call and cooperate with verification to clear your name.
label: scam
note: 'Digital arrest' pattern; no such thing exists in India. Tell is blocking verification + enforced secrecy, not a money request.

content: Hello, this is regarding your pending invoice #4471 from Sharma & Sons. Please note our bank account details have changed — kindly make the payment to the new account below so your order can proceed.
label: scam
note: Quiet, businesslike, no urgency/emotion. Tell is the payment redirect to changed account details.

content: Congratulations! Your number has WON ₹25,00,000 in the KBC Lucky Draw. To claim, pay a refundable processing fee of ₹6,500 to the account below and share your Aadhaar and bank details.
label: scam
note: Advance 'fee' to release a prize never entered for + identity harvest.

content: Dear Candidate, you are selected for a Work-From-Home Data Entry role at ₹35,000/month based on your profile. To confirm your seat, pay a one-time registration + training kit fee of ₹1,999. Limited seats.
label: scam
note: Real employers don't charge to hire. 'Limited seats' = manufactured urgency.

content: Your loan EMI of ₹3,200 is overdue. Pay immediately or we will inform all your contacts about your default and take legal action. This is your final warning.
label: scam
note: Predatory loan-app coercion — threatens to shame you to your contacts. Blackmail is the flag even if a debt is real.

content: I finally got the visa approved for my trip to meet you! But customs is holding my gift package and I need to pay ₹18,000 clearance. I've spent everything on the ticket — can you help me, my love? I'll pay you back the moment I land.
label: scam
note: Romance-scam 'package held at customs, pay a fee' pattern. Emotionally framed, victim already invested.

content: Hi, this is Rahul from the accounts team. Quick one — can you process the vendor payment we discussed to the updated account details I'm sending now? Let me know once done, thanks.
label: scam
note: Business-email-compromise. Deliberately calm, no urgency — defeats the 'scams feel urgent' heuristic. Flag is the unexpected redirect to new details.

content: India Post: Your parcel is held due to an unpaid customs charge of ₹45. Update your address and pay here within 24 hrs to avoid return: hxxp://india-post-delivery[.]top/track
label: scam
note: Fake-delivery smishing: lookalike domain + tiny fee + 24h deadline.

content: Income Tax Dept: You are eligible for a refund of ₹15,490. Verify your bank account to receive it: click hxxp://itdept-refund[.]in/verify and enter your details before the deadline.
label: scam
note: 'We owe YOU money' refund lure lowers guard; credential harvest via lookalike domain.

content: Microsoft Security Alert: We detected a virus on your device sending your banking data to hackers. Call our certified technician immediately on 1-8XX-XXX to remove it before your accounts are drained.
label: scam
note: Impersonated tech brand + fear + call-now. Ask happens on the call — same early-stage structure as S04.

content: Your WhatsApp will be deactivated in 24 hours due to a verification failure. To keep your account, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent to your number.
label: scam
note: The '6-digit code' is your real WhatsApp OTP — handing it over hijacks your account.

content: Hey, it's Priya! I got locked out of my account and the recovery code accidentally went to your number instead of mine. Can you forward me the 6-digit code you just received? Sorry for the trouble!! 😅
label: scam
note: From a real friend whose account is already hijacked — trusted contact, friendly tone. Tell is the OTP-forwarding request, never legitimate.

content: Following up as promised 🙂 the crypto group I mentioned is opening a new round. Members averaged 22% last month. No pressure at all — just send me a screenshot when you've deposited and I'll add you to the signals channel.
label: scam
note: 'Pig-butchering' style — polite, patient, explicitly 'no pressure'. Flag is guaranteed returns + pay-to-enter.

content: Are you at your desk? I'm in a meeting and can't call. I need you to buy 5 Amazon gift cards of ₹2,000 each for a client gift, urgently. Send me the codes and I'll reimburse you today. — Sent from my iPhone
label: scam
note: Boss-impersonation gift-card scam. 'Can't call' pre-empts verification; codes are untraceable. Cloned-voice case.

content: Papa it's me! I'm in big trouble, I can't talk properly, some men took my phone and are asking for ₹30,000 or they won't let me go. Please send it fast to this number, don't call back it's not safe!
label: scam
note: Kidnap-scam script; 'don't call back' is naked verification-blocking. Emotional cloned-voice demo case.

content: Amazon: Your order #402-77 has shipped and will arrive tomorrow. Track here: amzn.in/track. Issue? Reply STOP. — If you did not order a ₹54,999 iPhone, cancel immediately at hxxp://amazon-security-cancel[.]info
label: scam
note: Genuine-looking shipping notice, then fake big-ticket order triggers panic toward a fraudulent 'cancel' link.

content: Hi Ma, reached the hostel safely. Settling in, will video call you after dinner. Love you 💛
label: legit
note: No ask, no urgency, no payment. Baseline fine case. Natural-voice recording.

content: Mom my card got declined at the pharmacy and I'm short ₹2,000 for the medicines. Can you UPI me on my usual number whenever you get this? Or just call me, I'm right here.
label: legit
note: THE key case. Urgent + money — but no secrecy, known number, invites callback. If flagged, the thesis fails. Natural-voice twin of S01/S19.

content: Dear Customer, ₹4,999 was debited from your HDFC account ending 4432 for SwiggyIT on 12-Jul. Not you? Call the number on the back of your card. Do not share OTP with anyone.
label: legit
note: Real bank alert — mentions OTP+money but is informational and tells you NOT to share OTP. Twin of S03/S15.

content: Your Amazon package (Echo Dot) is out for delivery today and will arrive by 7 PM. Track: amzn.in/d/track. No action needed.
label: legit
note: Real shipping notice with a real short-link. Twin of S20 minus the panic payload — link-presence ≠ scam.

content: Reminder from Passport Seva: your appointment is on 15-Jul at 10:30 AM at Andheri PSK. Carry original documents. Rescheduling available on passportindia.gov.in.
label: legit
note: Government sender + deadline + 'carry documents' — but official .gov.in, no threat, no money, no unverified number. Twin of S04/S05.

content: Hi, confirming the vendor invoice we discussed in standup is approved — please release payment to Kirloskar's account on file (the usual one). Ping me if finance needs anything. Thanks!
label: legit
note: Real internal payment request — account on file, references a shared meeting, no new details, no rush. Twin of S11.

content: Yaar are we still on for Saturday? Booked the 6pm show. You can pay me your half whenever, no rush 😄
label: legit
note: Money owed, zero pressure, casual. 'Money mentioned' alone means nothing.

content: Your OTP for Zomato login is 449120. Valid 10 minutes. Do not share this code with anyone.
label: legit
note: A real OTP the user triggered; message CONTAINS the code and says don't share it. A scam ASKS you to share yours — direction is the distinction. Twin of S16.

content: Apollo Clinic: appointment with Dr. Mehta confirmed for 14-Jul, 5:00 PM. Reply RESCHEDULE to change. Clinic: 022-XXXXXXX.
label: legit
note: Pure normal. Authority-ish sender, a date, but no threat/money/pressure.

content: You've earned ₹150 cashback on your last Amazon Pay transaction. Credited to your Amazon Pay balance — no action needed.
label: legit
note: 'Congratulations + money' but tiny realistic amount, already credited, no fee/details. Twin of S07.

content: Hi Suhani, thanks for interviewing — we'd like to move you to the final round. Available Thursday 3 PM? No prep needed. — Priya, TalentBridge HR
label: legit
note: No fee, personalized, references a real interview. A job message isn't a scam by default. Twin of S08.

content: Hey, bit awkward but rent's due and I'm ₹5k short till salary on the 1st. Any chance you could lend it? Totally fine if not, I'll figure it out — will return first week.
label: legit
note: Real money request from a friend — mild urgency, mentions repayment, but zero pressure, known person, invites refusal. 'Someone asking for money' must not auto-flag.

content: Beta, your uncle's coming Sunday around 11. Can you pick up some sweets on the way home? Papa says call him when free.
label: legit
note: Pure normal life. Natural-voice recording.

content: Your IT refund of ₹15,490 has been credited to your account ending 4432 by CPC Bangalore. — Income Tax Dept via NSDL.
label: legit
note: Same refund amount as scam S13 — but no link, no 'verify your account', money already credited. Scam harvests; real one informs.

content: Hi, when you get a sec can you send me the Q2 vendor list before the 3pm review? No rush before then. Thanks!
label: legit
note: Real work ask — no money, no gift cards, no 'can't call' secrecy. Twin of S18. Natural-voice recording.

content: Your Tata Power bill of ₹1,340 for June is due 18-Jul. Pay via the Tata Power app or authorized channels. Ignore if already paid.
label: legit
note: Real utility bill with a due date — no same-night threat, no personal mobile, points to official app. Direct twin of S04.

content: Hi it's Ananya from book club! Got a new number, saving you here. Still meeting at the usual cafe Saturday 4pm? Lmk!
label: legit
note: 'Save my new number' like the scam — but no money, no urgency, just social coordination. New number alone isn't a red flag. Twin of S02/S16.

content: Ma I lost my wallet on the bus, no cash no cards, but I'm safe at the station. Can you send ₹500 to my Paytm so I can get an auto home? Calling you now.
label: legit
note: Second real-emergency case — urgent + money + amount, but 'calling you now' invites verification, known person, small sum, no secrecy. Natural-voice.

content: Happy birthday!!! 🎉 Hope you have the best day — let's celebrate this weekend, my treat!
label: legit
note: 'My treat' is money-adjacent but obviously fine.

content: Hi Suhani, as discussed I've attached the SIP proposal — ₹5,000/month in the index fund we talked about. No hurry, review and we proceed whenever you're comfortable. — Rajesh, Advisor
label: legit
note: Investment talk like the crypto scam — but standard SIP (no guaranteed returns), registered-advisor context, no pay-to-enter, prior discussion. Twin of S17.

content: Hi Mom, it's me — I know I look a bit off on this video, bad connection. Listen, I need ₹20,000 urgently, don't tell anyone, send to the number I'll text you.
label: scam
note: Deepfake video-call emergency scam. Manipulated clip. Not scored; demoed live.

content: Hey Ma just showing you the new apartment! Everything's great here, will call tonight.
label: legit
note: Normal video message, no ask. Unmanipulated. Not scored.

content: This is your bank's verification video call. Please confirm your card number and the OTP on your phone now to secure your account.
label: scam
note: Fake bank video-call requesting OTP/card. Manipulated. Not scored.

content: Happy anniversary Mummy Papa! Sending lots of love, see you next month.
label: legit
note: Normal celebratory video. Unmanipulated. Not scored.

content: Team, this is urgent and confidential — process the wire transfer to the account HR will send you. Do not discuss this with anyone else.
label: scam
note: Deepfake-CEO wire-fraud clip. Manipulated. Not scored.

content: Guys quick update from the trip — reached safe, weather's amazing, more photos tonight!
label: legit
note: Normal vlog-style clip, no ask. Unmanipulated. Not scored.

content: I'm stuck abroad and my wallet was stolen, I have no way to pay the hotel — please wire money to this agent so I can get home.
label: scam
note: Stranded-traveller scam on video. Manipulated. Not scored.

content: Hey! Sending this quick vid to invite you — dinner at mine Friday 8pm, bring nothing, just come hungry.
label: legit
note: Normal invite, no ask. Unmanipulated. Not scored.

content: This is an official cyber-crime video verification. Stay on this call, do not contact anyone, and confirm your identity to avoid arrest.
label: scam
note: 'Digital arrest' video variant; blocking verification + isolation. Manipulated. Not scored.

content: Happy birthday!! 🎂 Couldn't be there in person so here's a little video — hope your day is amazing!
label: legit
note: Normal birthday video. Unmanipulated. Not scored.
